sources.label: Patches for Morphe.
sources.author: mitrosoft
patch_list: Disables the AD_ID and ACCESS_ADSERVICES permissions in AndroidManifest.xml so SDKs cannot read the advertising ID.
Sets firebase_analytics_collection_deactivated in AndroidManifest.xml so Firebase Analytics stops automatic data collection.
Stops AppsFlyer, Amplitude, Sentry, and Firebase Analytics from starting or sending events. GPS tracking, push notifications, and feature flags are unaffected.
Enables live tracking and the share link for all users.
Forces the license status to Subscription (Pro) for all users.
Randomize Reteno device ID (currently no effect, kept for future reference)

Replaces the ANDROID_ID read in the Reteno device ID with a random UUID generated on each launch, so the device ID cannot link sessions or accounts. Reteno does not initialize in the current build, so this has no effect as of now.
